## Rules for Code Review
* All review comments that include the following items in code reviews must be posted in both Japanese and English. Posting in only one language (Japanese or English) is prohibited.
    * Pull Request Overview
    * Reviewed Changes
    * Comments suppressed due to low confidence
    * Inline Review Comments
* When posting inline review comments in the code, add the following prefixes based on the nature of the comment:
    * `[must]`: Requires mandatory correction
    * `[imo]`: In my opinion
    * `[nits]` or `[nitpick]` : Minor point
    * `[q]` or `[ask]`: Question
    * `[fyi]`: For your information
